title: Sandiganbayan to begin trial of Rep. Jojo Ang over alleged infra conflict of interest
summary: The trial of Uswag Ilonggo Rep. Jojo Ang on a graft charge over alleged conflict of interest in infrastructure projects is set to proceed before the Sandiganbayan Third Division.
